verdict.rationale: Yapily's docs describe a sandbox test environment where you connect your application to a bank and use test accounts to simulate the real Open Banking experience. That covers the story's core of testing without touching production data. Missing for 10: details on how sandbox credentials and environments are kept separate from production, the scope of sandbox coverage (payments vs. data, which institutions), any agent-specific sandbox workflow, and independent or hands-on confirmation that it works.
